description: This is a Java source file for a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController. It provides basic endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing endpoints for basic application functions such as welcome message, API docs redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects clients to the Swagger UI page, constructing the URL based on the incoming request, supporting proxy headers.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple 'OK' string indicating the application is healthy.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides application-specific information, typically the application name or version.
